title: HyPE-GT: where Graph Transformers meet Hyperbolic Positional Encodings
abstract: arXiv:2312.06576v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Graph Transformers (GTs) facilitate the comprehension of complex relationships on graph-structured data by leveraging self-attention of the possible pairs of nodes. The structural information or inductive bias of the input graph is provided as positional encodings to the GT. The positional encodings are mostly Euclidean and are not able to capture the complex hierarchical relationships of the corresponding nodes. To address the limitation, we introduce a novel and efficient framework, HyPE, that generates learnable positional encodings in the non-Euclidean hyperbolic space that capture the intricate hierarchical relationships of the underlying graphs. Unlike existing methods, HyPE can generate a set of hyperbolic positional encodings, empowering us to explore diverse options for the optimal selection of PEs for specific downstream tasks. translated_title: HyPE-GT：图变换器遇见双曲位置编码
translated_abstract: 图变换器（GTs）通过利用节点对的自注意力机制，促进了对图结构数据上复杂关系的理解。输入图的结构信息或归纳偏置以位置编码的形式提供给GT。这些位置编码大多是欧几里得式的，无法捕捉相应节点的复杂层次关系。为解决这一局限，我们引入了一种新颖且高效的框架HyPE，它在非欧几里得双曲空间中生成可学习的位置编码，以捕捉底层图的复杂层次关系。与现有方法不同，HyPE能够生成一组双曲位置编码，使我们能够探索针对特定下游任务最优PE选择的各种选项。此外，我们重新利用生成的双曲位置编码来减轻某些影响。
tldr: 本文提出HyPE框架，在双曲空间中生成可学习的位置编码，以捕捉图的层次结构，优于欧几里得方法，并提供多种PE选择以优化下游任务性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HyPE, a framework generating learnable positional encodings in hyperbolic space to capture hierarchical graph structures, outperforming Euclidean methods and offering diverse PE options for downstream task optimization.
